facts.fact: The Central Bank of Seychelles states the Financial Consumer Protection Act, assented 14 April 2022 and commencing 1 May 2022 with a six-month transitional period, is in force for financial consumers, with Complaint Handling Regulations 2024 and unfair contract terms guidelines listed under it.
